title: 第十三章天帝行惊众生第十四章缔结盟约承天效法厚德光大后土皇地祇
slug: 洪荒走向神话的大天尊
content_zh:
众大巫怒吼着冲上前去。
却又被按了回来，较刑天尤速。
那只金色巨掌仍落于同一处，直将众人与刑天挤作一团。刑天本已重伤在身，此番二次受创，闷哼一声，却咬牙不肯叫出声来。
昊天转头对瑶池道：“瑶池，看好天庭，我去幽冥走一遭，去去便回。”
瑶池尚未回过神来，只木然点了点头。
心中却翻起惊涛骇浪，昊天何时变得如此强大了？不都是大罗金仙么？修为不是与她伯仲之间么？
天帝权柄当真这般恐怖？可她的王母权柄为何觉着没那么大？为何自己全无变化？
瑶池满腹疑云，却知此时不便多问，只默默目送昊天离去。
昊天手一挥，那镇压刑天等人的金色巨掌化作一道道秩序锁链，至阳之气流转其上，压制着大巫体内的大道法则，将众人尽数禁锢。
为防这帮家伙聒噪扰耳，昊天索性连他们的嘴也一并堵了。
然后，便带着这几个“俘虏”，向血海而去。
后土开辟幽冥，便在血海之上，更吸去血海近半之力，故而幽冥门户就在血海之侧。
天帝出行，排面自然十足。太古星辰垂下浩荡星力，化作一架星光璀璨的车辇。昊天的至阳之道，则化为九条神龙，通体金光灿灿，龙威赫赫。
昊天登车，九条神龙齐声长啸，声震四野，随即撞开重重空间，向血海疾驰而去。一路上气势毫无遮掩，浩浩荡荡，所过之处，众生无不战栗。
至于那几个大巫，便被挂在车后，犹如示众一般。
“这……这是大罗金仙？那我算什么？修道这么多年，莫非修了个假的？”一位大罗金仙陷入深深的自我怀疑。
“这气息如此恐怖，比之当年的帝俊、太一也丝毫不差了吧！”一位曾见识过上古妖皇风采的老牌大能低声呢喃。
“不愧是道祖身边的人，实力当真恐怖。”
“看来天庭这回是真要翻身了。”
“刑天也算倒霉，撞上了这么个硬茬子。”

“何止刑天？只怕洪荒的格局，从此要变一变了。”
各路神念在虚空中交织，议论纷纷，有惊叹者，有忌惮者，有幸灾乐祸者，亦有暗中盘算者。
---
昆仑山，玉虚宫。
广成子等人感知到那股浩浩荡荡的气息，顿时脸色铁青。
他们万万没想到，一个小小的童子，竟能拥有如此恐怖的修为。先前在天庭被昊天当众落了脸面，他们心中还憋着一口气，想着日后寻机讨回。
如今感受到这股气势，那口气顿时泄了大半——不是对手，当真不是对手。
元始天尊端坐云床，手持三宝玉如意，目光微微闪动，却也并未太放在心上。
不成圣，终为蝼蚁。
实力再强又如何？难道还能比肩圣人？只要圣人不出，巫妖那般格局便是上限。昊天再强，也不过是另一个东皇太一罢了。
“且观后效。”元始天尊淡淡开口，便闭目入定，不再理会。
碧游宫，金鳌岛。
通天教主倒来了兴致，抚掌笑道：“有趣，有趣。这位小师弟，倒有几分本事。”
多宝道人拱手道：“师尊，那天帝的实力，怕是已不在当年东皇太一之下了。”
“何止不在其下？”通天教主摇头轻笑，“只怕犹有过之。不过嘛……”
他话锋一转，“圣人之下皆蝼蚁，这话虽然难听，却也是实话。且看他日后如何行事罢。”
多宝等人对昊天并无恶感，感知其强悍实力，反倒生出几分敬意。洪荒之中，强者为尊，此乃亘古不变之理。甚至有人暗暗生了前去请教一番的念头。
首阳山，八景宫。
太上老君依旧在丹炉前打盹，仿佛对这一切全不在意。炉中火焰轻轻跳动，映得他面容忽明忽暗。
“气势倒是够了，”他喃喃自语，声低几不可闻，“只是……这条路，可不好走啊。”

说罢，便又沉沉睡去。
混沌深处，娲皇宫。
女娲娘娘斜倚云床，把玩着一枚五色石。感知到昊天的气息，她微微挑眉，露出一丝诧异。
“这昊天的实力……”她沉吟片刻，摇了摇头，“倒是有趣。不过，与我无关。”
她自诞生以来，便不喜纷争。巫妖之战她未曾参与，龙汉大劫她置身事外。如今昊天崛起，只要不触及她的底线，她也懒得理会。
content_en:
The great witches roared and rushed forward.
But he was pushed back again, faster than Xing Tianyou.
The golden giant palm still landed on the same place, squeezing everyone into a ball with Xing Tian. Xingtian was already seriously injured, but this time he was injured for the second time. He groaned, but gritted his teeth and refused to scream.
Haotian turned to Yaochi and said: "Yaochi, keep an eye on Heaven. I'll go to Netherworld for a walk. I'll come back as soon as I go."
Yaochi hadn't come back to his senses yet, so he just nodded numbly.
There was a storm in my heart. When did Haotian become so powerful? Aren’t they all Daluo Jinxian? Isn't his cultivation on par with hers?
Is the power of the Emperor of Heaven really so terrifying? But why does her Queen Mother feel that her power is not so great? Why haven't I changed at all?
Yaochi was full of doubts, but he knew it was inconvenient to ask more questions at this time, so he just watched Haotian leave silently.
Haotian waved his hand, and the golden palm that suppressed Xing Tian and others turned into chains of order, and the Qi of the Sun flowed on them, suppressing the laws of the great witch in the body, and imprisoning everyone.
In order to prevent these guys from disturbing their ears with their noise, Haotian simply blocked their mouths as well.
Then, he took these "prisoners" and headed towards the sea of ​​blood.
After the earth opened up the Netherworld, it was above the Blood Sea, and it absorbed nearly half of the power of the Blood Sea, so the Netherworld portal was on the side of the Blood Sea.
When the Emperor of Heaven travels, his appearance is natural. The ancient stars dropped their mighty star power and transformed into a starry chariot. Haotian's Way to the Sun turned into nine divine dragons, with golden light shining all over their bodies, and the dragons were majestic.
Haotian boarded the car, and the nine divine dragons roared in unison, the sound shook the surrounding areas, and then they smashed through many spaces and galloped towards the sea of ​​blood. The momentum along the way was unconcealed and mighty, and all living beings trembled wherever it passed.
As for the big witches, they were hung behind the car as if they were on display.
"This... this is Da Luo Jinxian? Then who am I? After practicing Taoism for so many years, could it be that I have practiced a fake one?" A Da Luo Jinxian fell into deep self-doubt.
"This aura is so terrifying, it's no worse than the Emperor Jun and Taiyi back then!" A veteran powerful man who had seen the ancient Demon Emperor murmured in a low voice.
"As expected of the people around Dao Ancestor, their strength is truly terrifying."
"It seems that Heaven is really going to turn around this time."
"Xingtian is unlucky to have run into such a tough guy."
"Not just Xingtian? I'm afraid that the prehistoric situation will change from now on."
Various spiritual thoughts intertwined in the void, and there were many discussions. Some were amazed, some were afraid, some were gloating about the misfortune, and some were making secret calculations.
---
Kunlun Mountain, Yuxu Palace.
Guangchengzi and others felt the mighty aura, and their faces suddenly turned pale.
They never expected that a little boy could have such terrifying cultivation. Having been humiliated by Haotian in the heaven before, they were still holding their breath in their hearts, thinking about looking for an opportunity to get it back in the future.
Now that I felt this momentum, most of that tone was immediately released - I am not an opponent, I really am not an opponent.
Yuanshi Tianzun was sitting on the cloud bed, holding the Three Treasures and Jade Ruyi, his eyes flashed slightly, but he didn't take it too seriously.
If you don't become a saint, you will eventually become an ant.
So what if you are stronger? Can he still be compared to a saint? As long as the saint does not come out, the pattern of the lich is the upper limit. No matter how powerful Haotian is, he is just another Donghuang Taiyi.
"Let's see the effects." Yuanshi Tianzun said calmly, then closed his eyes and fell into concentration, no longer paying attention.
Biyou Palace, Jin'ao Island.
The leader of Tongtian Cult became interested, stroking his hands and smiling: "Interesting, interesting. This little junior brother is quite capable."
Taoist Duobao cupped his hands and said: "Master, I am afraid that the strength of the Heavenly Emperor is no longer inferior to that of Donghuang Taiyi."
"Isn't it better than that?" Leader Tongtian shook his head and chuckled, "I'm afraid it's more than that. But..."
He changed the topic and said, "Below the saints are all ants. Although this is unpleasant to hear, it is also true. Let's see how he behaves in the future."
Duobao and others have no ill feelings towards Haotian and perceive his strength.Strength actually gave rise to a bit of respect. In ancient times, the strong were respected. This is an eternal principle. Some people even secretly had the idea of ​​going to ask for advice.
Shouyang Mountain, Bajing Palace.
Taishang Laojun was still taking a nap in front of the alchemy furnace, as if he didn't care about all this. The flames in the furnace danced gently, making his face flicker.
"The momentum is enough," he murmured to himself, his voice barely audible, "It's just... this road is not easy to walk on."
After saying that, he fell asleep again.
Deep in the chaos, Wa Palace.
Empress Nuwa is leaning on the cloud bed, playing with a five-color stone. Sensing Haotian's aura, she raised her eyebrows slightly, showing a hint of surprise.
"This Haotian's strength..." She pondered for a moment and shook her head, "It's interesting. However, it has nothing to do with me."
Since her birth, she has disliked strife. She did not participate in the Lich War, and she stayed out of the Long-Han Tribulation. Now that Haotian is rising, she doesn't care as long as it doesn't touch her bottom line.
